details:
file-saver-bg is a dependency-confusion package: it was published on 2026-11-07 with the inflated version 9.9.9 to win version resolution over a private package of the same name. Both its `preinstall` and `postinstall` scripts run `node beacon.js`, which sends an HTTP GET over cleartext HTTP to the hardcoded IP endpoint `http://100.24.177.136/cb` with the package name, the machine's hostname, the OS user name, the current working directory and the platform as query parameters. The file calls itself an "AUTHORIZED dependency-confusion PoC". The package has no other code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder version carries no install script and is not affected. Any machine that installed 9.9.9 has disclosed its hostname, user name and filesystem layout to a third party; remove the package, pin or scope internal package names to the internal registry, and block 100.24.177.136 on build hosts.

## Source: amazon-inspector (dc60a9083c9eef36fa2df3fbf6f9123aea7ddcf1f244b28ce480f8440d0c6380)
file-saver-bg@9.9.9 is a dependency-confusion-shaped package (name resembles 'file-saver', implausibly high version 9.9.9 to win internal resolution) whose package.json declares both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts invoking beacon.js. beacon.js collects os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.cwd(), and os.platform() and transmits them as query parameters in an HTTP GET to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://100.24.177.136/cb. The beacon fires automatically on npm install without any user interaction, disclosing internal build-host identifiers to an attacker-controlled destination.

## Source: ghsa-malware (fb2c5b4b6b375b1e32fa020b91c41061e43028b84baded3d7ac0aa49fe67d2f7)
Any computer that has this package installed or running should be considered fully compromised. All secrets and keys stored on that computer should be rotated immediately from a different computer. The package should be removed, but as full control of the computer may have been given to an outside entity, there is no guarantee that removing the package will remove all malicious software resulting from installing it.
